descriptionHtml:
Exploring the boundless possibilities of antenna technology, the IEEE Microwave Theory and Techniques Society student branch chapter orchestrated a highly successful event on Wearable Antennas and Reflect Array Antennas. The enlightening session unfolded on July 14, 2023, at the DEEE seminar room and drew an engaged audience of over 50 participants eager to delve into the complexities of these cutting-edge technologies. Graced by the distinguished presence of two accomplished guest speakers, Prof. Malathi Kanagasabai and Dr. Gulam Nabi Alsath, both hailing from the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at the University of Anna in Chennai, India, the event offered a unique opportunity for attendees to gain profound insights into the latest advancements and practical applications of wearable antennas and reflect array antennas.

Prof. Malathi Kanagasabai and Dr. Gulam Nabi Alsath shared their extensive knowledge, enriching the discussion with perspectives from their research and practical experiences. The event not only provided a platform for academic discourse but also fostered a collaborative atmosphere where participants could explore the potential impact of these antenna technologies in diverse fields within the realm of microwave theory and techniques. The engagement and enthusiasm of both speakers and participants alike underscored the event's success in facilitating a deeper understanding of the evolving landscape of antenna applications.
venue: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Seminar Room, Faculty of Engineering
